evals.name: typography-and-heading-labels
evals.prompt: Elevate a two-line passage containing a spaced em dash, a doubled modifier ('plainly and unambiguously'), and bare heading enumerators ('1.' / 'A.') instead of full-path labels.
evals.expected_output: Removes the spaced em dash, cuts the doubled modifier, and relabels the headings to the full-path convention (e.g. 'I.' and 'I.A.' rather than bare '1.'/'A.').
expectations: No spaced em dashes ( — ) appear anywhere in the output
Heading labels use the full-path convention, not a bare enumerator
The doubled modifier is cut rather than left in place
Active-verb phrasing is preserved or improved

notes: Pilot regression eval added 2026-08-19 (delegation-batch Task #11) to test the Typography (em dash) and full-path heading-label rules landed in claude.md v0.9.0 (Task #8). CORRECTION (same day): the 'doubled modifier is cut' expectation does not test a claude.md rule -- claude.md has no doubled-modifier rule today. That rule exists only in KLG's Cowork org-level instructions (a separate layer from this repo). Left in the eval because it's a reasonable style check either way, but tracked as pending claude.md coverage in the backlog item logged 2026-08-19 ("Bring claude.md style rules in line with the firm's Cowork org-level instructions").
